events.title: v1.977 update: new captain looks, difficulty tuning, and many fixes
events.summary: Captains A new look for all five captain classes and their ascension forms: a refreshed art style. Armor, boots and trinkets now change on the captain as your gear tier rises. Capes now move with spring physics (turned off on the Low graphics tier). Captains also carry their tools while gathering. New Appearance row in the Armory: follow your equipment progress, or pick a full Basic, Advanced or Final set. Cosmetic only - stats are unchanged, and it applies from your next run. events.title: Demo Update: Broken Stele's Night & Reworked Boss Fights
events.summary: Hi everyone, This demo update (v1.976) gives Broken Stele his own boss night in 1-3, reworks the boss fights and cleans up a lot of on-screen text. We've also improved rebuilding and the wall-repair supply card, and fixed issues with card picks, co-op, display and sound. Broken Stele's night (1-3) A boss night. events.title: Demo Update v1.974: HD Animations, Clearer Card Effects, Co-op Fixes
events.summary: Hi everyone, v1.974 brings HD animations, clearer card effects and a round of co-op fixes to the demo. Here's what you'll notice on the battlefield. HD animations HD units. Recruitable soldiers, allies and most enemies now have HD animations, and hits land when the weapon connects, not during the wind-up. Bloated corpses warn you. events.title: Update: Co-op Polish
events.summary: Co-op Your teammates' soldiers now carry their full combat presence to your screen: arrows and shots in flight, hits landing, melee, and the heavy note of a soldier going down. events.title: Patch: Co-op Card Pick Freeze Fix, Plus a Smoother First Hour
events.summary: Co-op Fixed a co-op freeze that could leave card picks showing "waiting for teammate" for up to 45 seconds even after your teammate had picked. We found this thanks to a player's in-game F8 report — thank you for sending it in. We're continuing to monitor co-op sync closely; if anything still feels off, F8 is the fastest way to reach us. events.title: Patch Notes: Co-op Fixes, and What Comes After the Last Night
events.summary: Co-op Fixed: the joining player's squad no longer fails to refill during the day — this is the issue mentioned in the last update, and squads will stop shrinking night by night. The colossus now walks and sounds like it on the joining player's screen. Whoever finishes picking an upgrade first no longer starts moving early; both sides unlock together. events.title: Content Update: Endless Goes Deeper, Night One Reworked
events.summary: v1.960 puts two things front and center: a redesigned pace for Endless Mode, and a full rework of Chapter 1, Night One. Endless now opens in a way that catches you, and your daytime preparation genuinely changes how Night One goes. Endless Mode, Now With Depth We looked at the data: too many Endless runs are over within the first few minutes. events.summary: Thank you for the detailed reports. Fixed an issue where the third campaign mission could fail to end after the Colossus was defeated. Fixed a related countdown crash that could occur when the card-selection state became stuck. events.title: Unburied — Update: "The Fall Night" — a playable prologue of the night the kingdom fell
events.summary: Every vigil begins with a defeat. This update adds a story prologue. Years before your first watch, the royal city fell in a single night — and you were there. Not as a Warden, but as a captain on the wall: the alarm bell, the tide of dead pouring out of the dark, each wave larger and hungrier than the last. There is no winning this night. events.title: The Unburied demo is out — three vigils, and one night that never ends
events.summary: The demo is available now. What's in it: Three full campaign vigils — from the first alarm at a border outpost, through a blood-moon hunt, to the Bursting Front: a bone colossus wakes on the third night and starts walking at your gate. Endless — a vigil with no end, where dawn never really arrives. See how many nights your line holds.
